methodologyNotes: Roster covers twelve anemometers spanning professional weather meters (Kestrel), HVAC/duct thermo-anemometers (Extech, REED, Amprobe, Fluke, testo, General Tools) and budget consumer vane meters (BTMETER, HoldPeak, Proster, UNI-T), verified 2026-08-09 primarily via direct fetches of manufacturer pages (kestrelinstruments.com, extech.com, meters.uni-trend.com, reedinstruments.com, amprobe.com) where those succeeded, supplemented by search-engine-surfaced retailer/reseller copy where manufacturer sites rate-limited (testo.com, HTTP 429), bot-blocked (fluke.com, HTTP 403), or simply do not publish consumer pricing (Extech, REED, Amprobe, General Tools all sell through distributor networks with no listed price on their own sites); three seed products did not check out and were corrected/replaced rather than guessed at — "REED R4700SD" does not exist in REED's current Air Velocity Meters catalog (confirmed by fetching that category page directly) and was replaced with their actual current SD-card datalogging vane anemometer, the R4000SD; "Ambient Weather WM-4" and "WeatherFlow WEATHERmeter" could not be found as currently-sold products (Ambient Weather's own site and shop pages show no WM-4, and weatherflow.com now redirects to tempest.earth whose /weathermeter page 404s, consistent with that smartphone-dongle product line being discontinued) and were replaced with two verifiably real, currently-cataloged instruments, the Fluke 925 and Amprobe TMA10A; and "Dr.meter FB600" returned zero search results and does not appear in drmeter.com's own product catalog (which has no anemometer category at all) and was replaced with the General Tools DAF800, the closest real match to the seed-suggested "General Tools DAFM8" (also not a real model number). Several fields are left null rather than estimated: airflow_cfm_cmm and temperature_range where a fetched or surfaced source did not state that capability; priceUsd for seven of twelve entries (Extech 45158, UNI-T UT363, REED R4000SD, Fluke 925, Amprobe TMA10A, General Tools DAF800) where no live-fetched or search-surfaced dollar figure could be confirmed during this session, each documented in its own priceNote rather than guessed.

products.name: Kestrel 3500 Weather Meter
products.priceNote: Current price on kestrelinstruments.com (Nielsen-Kellerman's official storefront)

specs.wind_speed_range_ms: 0.6 to 40.0 m/s (1.3-89.5 mph); operational to 60.0 m/s
specs.velocity_accuracy: Larger of ±3% of reading or 20 ft/min
specs.data_hold_logging: No built-in logging on base 3500 (shows current/max/min/avg); optional USB/RS-232 PC interface cable sold separately for one-way data transfer

products.provenance: Fetched directly from Nielsen-Kellerman's official Kestrel Instruments product page: confirms 0.6-40.0 m/s wind speed range (±3% of reading or 20 ft/min accuracy, whichever is larger), -10 to 55°C operating temperature range with ±0.5°C accuracy, reflective LCD with manually-activated blue-white backlight, and $209.00 current price. The base 3500 has no built-in data logging (that starts at the Kestrel 4000/4500 series); a USB/RS-232 interface is available only as a separate accessory for one-way data transfer, not onboard storage.

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed model 'REED R4700SD' does not exist in REED Instruments' current catalog. Their own reedinstruments.com Air Velocity Meters category (fetched directly) lists twelve current products — R4100, R3001, R4000SD/-KIT/-KIT2, R4500SD/-KIT/-KIT2, R4100-PROBE, 8906, R1600/-KIT — with no R4700SD among them. The seed was replaced with REED's actual current SD-card data-logging vane anemometer, the R4000SD (the R4500SD is the equivalent hot-wire-probe sibling for low-velocity duct work, kept out to avoid duplicating the sensor type already covered by testo 405i). Specs fetched directly from REED's own R4000SD product page: 79-5906 fpm (0.4-30 m/s) vane range, ±(2%rdg+40fpm) accuracy, 72mm vane, 0-50°C ambient temperature with optional Type K/J thermocouple input, and SD datalogging up to 16GB, 1-3600 sec intervals. No price is shown on REED's own page (B2B distributor sales model).
